description: Lists the CIVIL NX tables the Bulk Tabular Result Exporter plugin can export, with each one's id, MIDAS TABLE_TYPE or /db endpoint, components and the arguments it takes: analysis results (reactions, displacements, beam/truss/plate/solid forces and stresses, links, cables, tendons, modes, composite sections, construction stage tables, 'all columns' for any TABLE_TYPE), calculated pre-process tables, and every model data table (/db/NODE, ELEM, SECT, loads, stages, combinations…). Filter with scope, search or id. Needs no model. Use it to pick the table id for preview_result_table and export_result_tables.

id.description: One table id, with its full description.

scope.description: pre = model data and pre-process tables; post = analysis results.

search.description: Words in the id, name, category, TABLE_TYPE or DB key, e.g. 'beam', 'reaction', 'tendon'.

name: result_table_catalog
title: Result and model tables the exporter knows
